blocks.text: Alyana Asistio has officially entered motherhood, announcing the arrival of her firstborn, baby girl Aviah. Asistio introduced her daughter to the public through the actress’ Instagram page on Wednesday, Sept. 16, a week after Aviah was born. “It’s only been 7 days, but the love I have for you is something I never knew I could feel,” the actress addressed her baby. “I’ve always dreamed of becoming a Mom one day. And now, here I am, holding you everyday.” Asistio recounted her birth journey, narrating the intense pain she endured during labor and how seeing Aviah for the first time made […]...
